address: 16 Haji Zeynalabdin Taghiyev St, 1005 Baku, Azerbaijan
name: Nizami Boutique Hotel
description:
Sign in to unlock the members-only price for your selected dates at Nizami Boutique Hotel


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: Nizami Boutique Hotel in Baku offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes a work desk, minibar, and free WiFi, ensuring a pleasant stay.

Dining Experience: Guests can enjoy a traditional restaurant serving local cuisine with halal and vegetarian options. The terrace provides a relaxing outdoor dining area, while the continental breakfast is available in-room.

Convenient Facilities: The hotel features a 24-hour front desk, paid shuttle service, and a tour desk. Additional amenities include a terrace, balcony, and free toiletries, catering to all guest needs.

Prime Location: Located 9 minutes from Maiden Tower and less than 1 km from Palace of The Shirvanshahs, the hotel is close to attractions such as Azerbaijan Carpet Museum and Freedom Square. Heydar Aliyev International Airport is 25 km away.Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 9.3 for a one-person stay.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
